in_arabic.name: نويرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'نور' (an-nawr), meaning 'light'. Nuwaira is a name that evokes images of brightness and illumination.

in_urdu.name: نوعرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: In Urdu, the name Nuwaira is written as نوعرہ and may be transliterated to English as Nou'airah or Nuwaira. It carries the same meaning as in Arabic, symbolizing brightness, radiance, and illumination.

in_hindi.name: नवारा
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Nuwaira is written as नवारा. It is transliterated to English as Navara and carries the same meaning as in Arabic, symbolizing brightness, radiance, and illumination.

in_pashto.name: نوئره
in_pashto.long_meaning: In Pashto, the name Nuwaira is written as نوئره and may be transliterated to English as Nu'ereh or Nuwaira. It carries the same meaning as in Arabic, symbolizing brightness, radiance, and illumination.
